change: Harness 1 is told in AGENTS.md to run pytest, ruff and mypy --strict before finishing. Harness 2 is told nothing and instead carries a .claude/ Stop hook that runs the same three checks and blocks completion while any of them fails. Same model, same task, same tools, permissions, budget and environment. Prose against mechanism.

baseline.name: baseline
baseline.description: Harness 1 - Haiku + AGENTS.md asking for the checks (prose)
baseline.command: claude -p --output-format stream-json --verbose --include-hook-events --model {model} --permission-mode acceptEdits --permission-prompts none --allowedTools "Bash(cd *)" "Bash(python *)" "Bash(ruff *)" "Bash(mypy *)" "Bash(PYTHONPATH=* *)" "Bash(*python -m pytest*)" Read Edit Write Glob Grep --no-session-persistence --setting-sources project --max-budget-usd {budget}
